targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Companies to scrape. Each item: { domain, firstName?, lastName? }. firstName/lastName let the scraper flag a name-matched personal email.

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Max pages per domain
maxPagesPerDomain.description: Homepage + discovered contact pages, capped at this many total.

pageKeywords.title: Page keywords (optional override)
pageKeywords.description: Override the default contact-page keyword list. Each item: { kw, priority } (lower priority = fetched sooner).

useProxy.title: Use residential proxy
useProxy.description: Route the fingerprint + browser tiers through Apify residential proxies (small extra cost; beats IP-reputation blocks).

unblockerKey.title: Unblocker API key
unblockerKey.description: Managed unblocker (ScrapFly-class) key for tier 5. Leave blank to stop the ladder at tier 4.
